environment.description: Go microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (i-0a3f7c2e9b) in us-east-1, public subnet with IGW route, Security Group sg-04a8b2c1d allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or load balancer in front. Service binds directly to 0.0.0.0:8080. Instance has public IPv4 via EIP.
